newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grenfell raises Compaq EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grenfell raises Compaq EPS.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said analyst Michael Kwatinetz raised his earnings estimates on Compaq Computer Corp for the current quarter and the 1997 year and reiterated his buy rating on the stock.
The brokerage said its PC analyst raised his projection for Compaq's fourth quarter ending this month to $1.63 per share from $1.46 per share previously.
He estimated that Compaq would earn $5.85 per share in fiscal 1997, up from $5.55 a share, the brokerage said.
Compaq shares surged 2-3/8 to 84-1/4 in active trade.
